verdicts.reason: A shrinks everything: the quote copy is small, the attribution is tiny and hard to read, and the quote mark, quote and attribution are spread out with big uneven gaps, so the group falls apart in a mostly empty tall canvas. B has a larger quote and a more readable attribution, but the whole block sits in the lower half under a big empty top area, the attribution is jammed right under the quote, and the gap between the quote mark and the copy is too big, so the spacing still needs fixing.
